rows.text: At its meeting on 28 November 2005, the Monetary Council considered the latest economic and monetary developments and left the central bank base rate unchanged at 6.00%.
The minutes of today's Council meeting will be published at 2 p.m. on 9 December 2005.
The Council also set the dates for its meetings in 2006 (every second scheduled meeting is interest rate-setting meeting):
The dates of electronic publication of the Bank's Quarterly Report on Inflation in 2006 are as follows:
The Monetary Council will issue a statement on its assessment of economic conditions simultaneously with publication of the Report.
The Report on Financial Stability will be published once a year from 2006.
The Monetary Council will issue a statement on its assessment of economic conditions simultaneously with publication of the Report.
The dates of publication of abridged minutes of the Council's rate-setting meetings are as follows:
At its meeting, the Council also discussed the November 2005 issue of the Quarterly Report on Inflation.
Simultaneously with publication of the Report, the Council is releasing its own press statement.
